summary: Extra variables passed with -e/--extra-vars have the highest variable precedence and effectively override most other configuration sources, for example -e ansible_user=brian beats -u carol.
questions: How do I override every other variable from the command line?
What is the highest precedence variable in Ansible?
How do I pass a variable at runtime to ansible-playbook?

answer_card.title: Use -e to override everything
answer_card.answer_md:
Extra vars (`-e` / `--extra-vars`) have the highest precedence of all variables, and because variables outrank keywords, options and config, they win over almost everything.

```shell
ansible -u carol -e 'ansible_user=brian' -a whoami all
```

This connects as `brian`, not `carol`. You must supply both the variable name and its value.
